SEARCH
Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Interface SceneBuilder

public interface SceneBuilder
Builds a complete caller-supplied engine-neutral scene owned by one RendererClient. Missing world, chunk, block, entity, structure, or resolved visual evidence is rejected rather than guessed by the provider.
